Package de.nexus.antixray.api

Enum Class AntiXRayFeature

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<AntiXRayFeature>
de.nexus.antixray.api.AntiXRayFeature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<AntiXRayFeature>, Constable
public enum AntiXRayFeature extends Enum<AntiXRayFeature>
The features of NexusAntiXRay that can be switched individually, globally under features in config.yml and per world under worlds.overrides.<world>.features.

Later versions of the API may add constants. A switch over this enum needs a default branch.

Since:
1.0.0

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ENTITY_CULLING
    Entities other than players are not sent to a player who cannot see them.
    FAKE_BLOCKS
    Fake ore veins inside solid rock.
    HIDE_BLOCKS
    Blocks of the hide list (ores and others) are sent as stone, deepslate, netherrack or end stone until the player has a line of sight to them.
    LIGHT_MASKING
    The light of hidden light sources and filled structures is removed from what the player receives.
    PLAYER_CULLING
    Other players are not sent to a player who cannot see them.
    STRUCTURE_CULLING
    Configured structures (and monster rooms) are sent filled with stone until the player gets close or sees them.
    TILE_CULLING
    Block entities such as chests, furnaces and spawners are hidden until the player can see them.
